name: tradrl-data
description: Historical dataset/event import (W020): typed dataset descriptors with honest fidelity declarations (source, range, known gaps), historical bar/trade/quote record shapes whose occurredAt/availableAt come from the record (A7), event adapters mapping records onto the W004 journal event envelope, and a pure deterministic loader producing journal-ready event records (engine-appendable drafts + restore-path records). No fetching — real datasets arrive through W021/W026 adapters.
